Literal hypotheses of complex.tex: C is any commutative ring; h>=1; I=(z_1,...,z_h); lambda is nonnegative additive on modules killed by a power of I, lambda(0)=0, and common-power zero-length direct sums and filtered colimits have length zero. mu=lambda(C/I) is positive finite, lambda(C/(z_1^a,...,z_h^a))=a^h mu, and positive Koszul homology has length zero for every a>=1. F is finite free in degrees 0,...,h and contractible off V(I).

Under CTX_COMPLEX, all H_i(F) are killed by a power of I and have finite length, and lambda H_i(F)=0 for i>0. If sum_i (-1)^i b_i=0 and all differential entries lie in I^s, s>=1, then lambda H_0(F)>=mu s^h (b_0-(A_h/s)sum_i b_i), with A_1=0 and A_h=max{h,3(h-1)h^(h-1)/(2(h-1)!)} for h>=2. No Noetherianity or completeness of C is assumed.

Let Y=Proj(Rees_I C) and F_Y the pullback of F. For every integer k the algebraic and blowup hyperhomology have the same finite lambda-length: lambda H_k(F)=lambda H_k(RGamma(Y,F_Y)). The comparison needs no alternating-rank, Noetherianity, or completeness hypothesis. Alternating rank zero further gives chi_lambda(F_Y tensor V)=rank(V) lambda H_0(F) for every vector bundle V pulled back from P_Z^(h-1).

All H_i(F) are killed by one power of I and have finite lambda-length; their positive-degree lengths vanish. This follows by nullhomotopies of parameter powers, Koszul-cone splittings preserving F, and a finite Koszul-first spectral sequence.

The degreewise kernel of (C/I)[Z_1,...,Z_h] -> gr_I C has lambda-length zero. Consequently lambda(C/I^M)=mu binomial(M+h-1,h), and projective-space to exceptional-divisor cohomology comparisons for bundles from P_Z^(h-1) are isomorphisms modulo length zero with finite lengths.

For D=F_Y tensor V or G tensor V, where G_i=O_Y(-is)^(b_i), there is q_D such that all inclusions D(j+M)->D(j) induce zero on hyperhomology for every integer j and M>=q_D. For h>=2 let rho_j be the root of H prime in (-(j+1),-j), H(x)=product_{i=1}^h(x+i). Each root is at least 1/h from its interval endpoints. For s>=h set r_j=floor(s rho_j). claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace ComplexEstimate

section Filtrations

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
variable (M : ℕ → Type*) [∀ i, AddCommGroup (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]

def descend (d : ∀ i, M (i + 1) →ₗ[R] M i) (a : ℕ) :
    (n : ℕ) → M (a + n) →ₗ[R] M a
  | 0 => LinearMap.id
  | n + 1 => (descend d a n).comp (d (a + n))

theorem descend_mem
    (d : ∀ i, M (i + 1) →ₗ[R] M i)
    (fil : ∀ i, ℕ → Submodule R (M i))
    (low : ∀ i k (x : M (i + 1)),
      x ∈ fil (i + 1) (k + 1) → d i x ∈ fil i k)
    (a n k : ℕ) (x : M (a + n))
    (hx : x ∈ fil (a + n) (k + n)) :
    descend M d a n x ∈ fil a k := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simpa [descend] using hx
  | succ n ih =>
      have hy : d (a + n) x ∈ fil (a + n) (k + n) :=
        low (a + n) (k + n) x hx
      exact ih (d (a + n) x) hy

theorem descend_eq_zero
    (d : ∀ i, M (i + 1) →ₗ[R] M i)
    (fil : ∀ i, ℕ → Submodule R (M i))
    (low : ∀ i k (x : M (i + 1)),
      x ∈ fil (i + 1) (k + 1) → d i x ∈ fil i k)
    (n : ℕ) (bottom : ∀ i, fil i 0 = ⊥) (top : ∀ i, fil i n = ⊤)
    (a : ℕ) :
    descend M d a n = 0 := by
  ext x
  have hx : x ∈ fil (a + n) (0 + n) := by simp [top]
  have hy := descend_mem M d fil low a n 0 x hx
  simpa [bottom] using hy

end Filtrations

section Images

variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
variable {H BN BM T : Type*}
variable [AddCommGroup H] [Module R H]
variable [AddCommGroup BN] [Module R BN]
variable [AddCommGroup BM] [Module R BM]
variable [AddCommGroup T] [Module R T]

theorem stabilized_range
    (iN : H →ₗ[R] BN) (iM : H →ₗ[R] BM)
    (t : BN →ₗ[R] BM) (δ : BM →ₗ[R] T)
    (compatible : t.comp iN = iM)
    (exactM : LinearMap.range iM = LinearMap.ker δ)
    (dies : δ.comp t = 0) :
    LinearMap.range t = LinearMap.range iM := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [exactM]
    change δ (t x) = 0
    simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun dies x
  · intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨iN x, ?_⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun compatible x

theorem stabilized_unique
    (iN : H →ₗ[R] BN) (iM : H →ₗ[R] BM)
    (t : BN →ₗ[R] BM) (δ : BM →ₗ[R] T)
    (compatible : t.comp iN = iM)
    (exactM : LinearMap.range iM = LinearMap.ker δ)
    (dies : δ.comp t = 0) (injective : Function.Injective iM)
    (y : BM) (hy : y ∈ LinearMap.range t) :
    ∃! x : H, iM x = y := by
  rw [stabilized_range iN iM t δ compatible exactM dies] at hy
  rcases hy with ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, fun z hz => injective (hz.trans hx.symm)⟩

end Images

theorem normalize_error
    (length mu power lead rank0 error budget : ℝ)
    (hlead : 0 < lead) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hpower : 0 ≤ power)
    (positive : 0 ≤ lead * (length - mu * power * rank0) + mu * power * error)
    (bounded : error ≤ lead * budget) :
    mu * power * (rank0 - budget) ≤ length := by
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left bounded (mul_nonneg hmu hpower)
  have h' := positive.trans (add_le_add_left h (lead * (length - mu * power * rank0)))
  apply (mul_le_mul_left hlead).mp
  nlinarith [h']

end ComplexEstimate

    rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [exactM]
    change δ (t x) = 0
    simpa using DFunLike.congr_fun dies x
  · intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨iN x, ?_⟩
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun compatible x

theorem stabilized_unique
    (iN : H →ₗ[R] BN) (iM : H →ₗ[R] BM)
    (t : BN →ₗ[R] BM) (δ : BM →ₗ[R] T)
    (compatible : t.comp iN = iM)
    (exactM : LinearMap.range iM = LinearMap.ker δ)
    (dies : δ.comp t = 0) (injective : Function.Injective iM)
    (y : BM) (hy : y ∈ LinearMap.range t) :
    ∃! x : H, iM x = y := by
  rw [stabilized_range iN iM t δ compatible exactM dies] at hy
  rcases hy with ⟨x, hx⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, fun z hz => injective (hz.trans hx.symm)⟩

end Images

theorem normalize_error
    (length mu power lead rank0 error budget : ℝ)
    (hlead : 0 < lead) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu) (hpower : 0 ≤ power)
    (positive : 0 ≤ lead * (length - mu * power * rank0) + mu * power * error)
    (bounded : error ≤ lead * budget) :
    mu * power * (rank0 - budget) ≤ length := by
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left bounded (mul_nonneg hmu hpower)
  have h' := positive.trans
    (add_le_add (le_refl (lead * (length - mu * power * rank0))) h)
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hlead).mp
  nlinarith [h']

end ComplexEstimate

claims.natural_statement: For every h,s>=1, let A=Q[u_1,u_2,...], K=Frac(A), C=A[z_1,...,z_h], I=(z_1,...,z_h), and lambda(M)=dim_K(M tensor_A K), with infinite dimension assigned infinity. This genuinely non-Noetherian example satisfies every length and parameter-Koszul hypothesis. The Koszul complex F on z_1^s,...,z_h^s is free in degrees 0,...,h, contractible off V(I), has differential entries in I^s, ranks binomial(h,i), and lambda H_0(F)=s^h. Thus coefficient one cannot be improved to 1+eta with a dimension-only O(1/s) error at fixed ranks.
